# Maintained Linux D-Bus migration

Source: crates.io atspi-connection 0.13.0, https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/atspi-connection/0.13.0/download. Original manifest and VCS metadata preserved with upstream MIT/Apache licenses.

Migrates the optional default AT-SPI connection API to zbus 6 alongside the protocol/proxy crates; no feature is removed. User authorized bounded downstream Linux migration on 2026-10-18.

See [ADR-011](../../docs/adr/ADR-011-linux-dbus-maintenance.md) for maintenance and acceptance contracts.

`ferrostage-provenance.json` records the original archive hash, VCS identity, file changes and complete maintained file hashes.
